# Index

Terms a reader looks up. Each row links the pages whose level-2 or level-3 headings, or index markers, use that term. Sections run A to Z, then digits, then every other first character. US English case-folding (Unicode lowercase) decides the order and which spellings are the same term.

Writers mark a term on a page they own. The marker is an HTML comment, so it does not show when the page is rendered:

```html
<!-- index: Lockstep -->
<!-- index: Dedicated server | see: Listen server -->
```

A marker with `see` names another term and adds no page link of its own. This page is generated. Do not edit it by hand.
